dashboard.label: Analyst OpenCTI Threat Match Overview
dashboard.description: IOC matches summarized from your telemetry with drilldowns to raw events.

search.query: index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:* | fields _time sourcetype kind ioc score hits match_value ip hash url_candidate last_seen src_index created_by confidence labels | eval last_seen_str=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

| search sourcetype="opencti:file_hash_match" | eval indicator=coalesce(hash,ioc,match_value) | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by indicator | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:dns_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval domain=coalesce(match_value, fqdn, domain, ioc) | where isnotnull(domain) AND domain!="" | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by domain | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count
| search sourcetype="opencti:url_match" | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by url_candidate | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:ip_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by ip | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:email_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval email=lower(email) | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by email ioc score role | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:dns_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval domain=coalesce(match_value, fqdn, domain, ioc) | where isnotnull(domain) AND domain!="" | eval hits=if(isnum(hits), hits, 1) | stats sum(hits) as hits earliest(first_seen) as first_seen latest(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels values(created_by) as created_by max(confidence) as confidence by domain ioc score | eval indicator=domain, type="domain", "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | lookup opencti_seenbefore_kv indicator,type OUTPUT ioc_rating decided_at decided_by note | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating, "Unreviewed") | eval seen_again=if(isnotnull(decided_at) AND last_seen>decided_at, "Yes","No") | eval created_by=mvjoin(created_by, ", ") | rename domain AS Domain score AS Score labels AS Tags created_by AS "Created By" confidence AS Confidence hits AS "Times Seen" src_index AS Index | table Rating Domain "Times Seen" Tags Score "Created By" Confidence note "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" Index | rename note AS Notes | sort - hits | head 20

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:ip_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval hits=if(isnum(hits), hits, 1) | stats sum(hits) as hits earliest(first_seen) as first_seen latest(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels values(created_by) as created_by max(confidence) as confidence by ip ioc score | eval indicator=ip, type="ip", "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | lookup opencti_seenbefore_kv indicator,type OUTPUT ioc_rating decided_at decided_by note | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating, "Unreviewed") | eval seen_again=if(isnotnull(decided_at) AND last_seen>decided_at, "Yes","No") | eval created_by=mvjoin(created_by, ", ") | rename ip AS IP score AS Score labels AS Tags created_by AS "Created By" confidence AS Confidence hits AS "Times Seen" src_index AS Index | table Rating IP "Times Seen" Tags Score "Created By" Confidence note "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" Index | rename note AS Notes | sort - hits | head 20

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:url_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval hits=if(isnum(hits), hits, 1) | stats sum(hits) as hits earliest(first_seen) as first_seen latest(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels values(created_by) as created_by max(confidence) as confidence by url_candidate ioc score | eval indicator=url_candidate, type="url", "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | lookup opencti_seenbefore_kv indicator,type OUTPUT ioc_rating decided_at decided_by note | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating, "Unreviewed") | eval seen_again=if(isnotnull(decided_at) AND last_seen>decided_at, "Yes","No") | eval created_by=mvjoin(created_by, ", ") | rename url_candidate AS URL score AS Score labels AS Tags created_by AS "Created By" confidence AS Confidence hits AS "Times Seen" src_index AS Index | table Rating URL "Times Seen" Tags Score "Created By" Confidence note "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" Index | rename note AS Notes | sort - hits | head 20

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:email_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval email=lower(email) | eval hits=if(isnum(hits), hits, 1) | stats sum(hits) as hits earliest(first_seen) as first_seen latest(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels values(created_by) as created_by latest(confidence) as confidence by email ioc score role | eval indicator=email, type="email", "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | lookup opencti_seenbefore_kv indicator,type OUTPUT ioc_rating decided_at decided_by note | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating, "Unreviewed") | eval seen_again=if(isnotnull(decided_at) AND last_seen>decided_at, "Yes","No") | eval created_by=mvjoin(created_by, ", ") | rename email AS Email score AS Score labels AS Tags created_by AS "Created By" confidence AS Confidence hits AS "Times Seen" src_index AS Index role AS Role | table Rating Email "Times Seen" Tags Score "Created By" Confidence note "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" Index Role | rename note AS Notes | sort - hits | head 20

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:file_hash_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval hits=if(isnum(hits), hits, 1) | stats sum(hits) as hits earliest(first_seen) as first_seen latest(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels values(created_by) as created_by max(confidence) as confidence by hash ioc score | eval indicator=hash, type="file", "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | lookup opencti_seenbefore_kv indicator,type OUTPUT ioc_rating decided_at decided_by note | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating, "Unreviewed") | eval seen_again=if(isnotnull(decided_at) AND last_seen>decided_at, "Yes","No") | eval created_by=mvjoin(created_by, ", ") | rename hash AS Hash score AS Score labels AS Tags created_by AS "Created By" confidence AS Confidence hits AS "Times Seen" src_index AS Index | table Rating Hash "Times Seen" Tags Score "Created By" Confidence note "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" Index | rename note AS Notes | sort - hits | head 20
